title: DevFest Berlin 2026
description: Berlin's flagship community-driven developer festival organized by local Google Developer Groups. Coming to SRH Berlin on November 14, 2026.

legal.representedBy: the board: Tsz Ho Tsai (chair), Aleksandr Mir (deputy chair), Elmira Jamaljamaliannezhad (secretary)

venue.name: SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences

speakerPerks.title: Full Conference Pass
speakerPerks.description: Complimentary all-day access to all keynote sessions, workshops, catering, and social events.

speakerPerks.title: Talk Recording & Exposure
speakerPerks.description: High-definition session recording published to community channels to share your expertise globally.

speakerPerks.title: Support for First-Time Speakers
speakerPerks.description: Slide coaching, dry-run feedback, and dedicated speaker buddies for new and underrepresented voices.

organizers.name: GDG Berlin
organizers.description: The flagship Google Developer Group in Berlin covering modern web, AI, cloud, and open developer technologies.

organizers.name: Berlindroid
organizers.description: Berlin's vibrant Android developer community hosting regular monthly technical talks, networking, and discussions.

organizers.name: GDG Berlin Cloud
organizers.description: Dedicated to Google Cloud Platform, distributed systems, Kubernetes, DevOps, and cloud-native architectures.

organizers.name: GDG Berlin Golang
organizers.description: The Berlin community for the Go programming language, backend systems engineering, and high-concurrency tooling.

organizers.name: WTM Berlin
organizers.description: Women Techmakers Berlin provides visibility, community support, mentorship, and resources for women in tech.

organizers.name: GDG on Campus SRH Berlin
organizers.description: Student-led developer community at SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences learning and building real-world projects.

organizers.name: Flutter Berlin
organizers.description: Berlin's meetup for multi-platform development using Flutter and Dart across mobile, web, and desktop.

sponsorship.title: Partner with DevFest Berlin
sponsorship.pitch: DevFest Berlin is run by volunteers from Berlin's developer communities. Partners make it possible, and meet more than 200 developers, designers and tech leads in one day.

needs.title: Food & catering
needs.text: Lunch, snacks and drinks for everyone through the day, or funds to book a caterer.

needs.title: Swag & supplies
needs.text: Lanyards, speaker and volunteer gifts, printed signage, decorations, coffee and tea.

needs.title: Marketing & branding
needs.text: Printed materials, social media promotion, a photo booth or a mascot appearance.

newsletter.title: Stay tuned for DevFest Berlin 2026
newsletter.description: Be the first to hear when ticket registration opens, speaker lineups are revealed, and full schedule details go live for November 14th at SRH Berlin.
